description: This file contains classes and functions for interacting with BuildBot, fetching layout test results from Google Storage, and managing build information. It includes classes like Build and BuildBot, and functions for URL generation, fetching test results, and filtering builds.

classes.name: Build
classes.description: Represents a build with a builder name and optional build number. If build number is None, it indicates the latest build for that builder.

classes.name: BuildBot
classes.description: Provides methods to generate URLs for build results, fetch retry summaries, and retrieve layout test results from Google Storage.

methods.name: results_url
methods.description: Returns a URL for archived layout test results for a specific build and builder.

methods.name: builder_results_url_base
methods.description: Generates the base URL for a builder's directory in Google Storage.

methods.name: fetch_retry_summary_json
methods.description: Fetches the retry summary JSON file for a given build, containing test retry results.

methods.name: accumulated_results_url_base
methods.description: Returns the URL for the accumulated layout test results for a builder.

methods.name: latest_layout_test_results
methods.description: Fetches the latest layout test results for a builder.

methods.name: fetch_results
methods.description: Fetches layout test results for a specific build.

methods.name: fetch_layout_test_results
methods.description: Retrieves layout test results from a URL and returns a LayoutTestResults object.

methods.name: _fetch_file
methods.description: Fetches a file from a URL constructed from a base URL and filename.
